name: fish
summary: The friendly interactive shell: autosuggestions, syntax highlighting, completions from man pages and a web/CLI config tool, all built in.
startupCostMs: Not measured here. fish ships its features built in, so a bare start is typically a few ms to tens of ms; cost comes from config.fish and conf.d (nvm, conda, eval-style inits). Measure with fish --profile-startup.

windows.notes: No native Windows build (fish 4.x targets Unix). Works inside WSL (apt install fish), MSYS2 or Cygwin. For native Windows prefer PowerShell, Git Bash or nushell.

macos.notes: To make it the login shell: add its path to /etc/shells, then chsh -s <path>. Homebrew's PATH is not set by default on Apple Silicon: eval (/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv) in config.fish.

linux.notes: Config dir honors $XDG_CONFIG_HOME. Distro packages can lag the current release; the upstream project also publishes apt/OBS repos.

prompt.notes: fish_prompt / fish_right_prompt functions; fish_config prompt picks sample prompts.

line-editing.notes: Autosuggestions, syntax highlighting, pager and abbreviations are built in.
